{{Quote|I have a friend, a trader in hardwoods, who was on Kashyyyk when the Imperials launched their attack on a place called Kachirho.|A [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] worker|<ref name="DarkLord">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>}}
[[File:AkrisUretuGreelWoodDesk-Insider136.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Greel wood was a type of hardwood.]]
'''Hardwood''' was a type of [[Wood/Legends|wood]].<ref name="Teebo">''[[The Adventures of Teebo: A Tale of Magic and Suspense]]''</ref> [[Apocia]],<ref name="Journal11">{{JournalCite|11|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref> [[Corellian hardwood]],<ref name="Cestus">''[[The Cestus Deception]]''</ref> [[Greel wood/Legends|greel]],<ref name="EnterTheUnknown">''[[Enter the Unknown]]''</ref> [[homogoni]],<ref name="CSWE homogoni">{{CSWECite|II|55|homogoni}}</ref> [[Taboon hardwood]],<ref name="KOTOR1">[[Knights of the Old Republic 1|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 1]]</ref> [[Veshok wood/Legends|veshok]],<ref name="Order66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> and [[Vosso wood|vosso]] were all hardwoods.<ref name="Pandemonium">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Pandemonium]]''</ref>
